g.text: Adds student to the docker and clab_admins groups, makes the
trusted lab folders group-writable and sets the containerlab
SUID bit, which VS Code Remote-SSH with the Containerlab
extension needs. Lab operations must already be enabled
The manager and its data. Nothing is rebuilt.
